exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which picture shows: fishing boats, a restaurant, a stone cottage, a ferry boat, an airport, a donkey, a bicycle, a souvenir shop, a guest house, green fields?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Qaysi rasmda ko'rsatilgan: baliqchi qayiqlari, restoran, tosh kulba, parom, aeroport, eshak, velosiped, sovg'a do'koni, mehmon uyi, yashil dalalar?
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT 9 — 'Times Change...' (Zamon o'zgaradi...)

MAVZU: joylar va binolar; o'tmish va hozirni qiyoslash.

Bu unitda O'TGAN ZAMON boshlanadi:
  was / were — 'be' ning o'tgan zamoni
  had — 'have' ning o'tgan zamoni
  could — 'can' ning o'tgan zamoni

O'N TA RASM (A dan J gacha) IKKI BETGA YOYILGAN:
  62-betda: A, C, D, F, G, I
  63-betda: B, E, H, J

KITOBDA BERILGAN: fishing boats = A

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a stone cottage = tosh kulba (kichik qishloq uyi)
  a ferry boat = parom (odam va mashina tashiydi)
  a donkey = eshak
  a souvenir shop = sovg'a (esdalik) do'koni
  a guest house = mehmon uyi (kichik mehmonxona)
  green fields = yashil dalalar

exercises.instructionEn: Inishmore is a small island off the west coast of Ireland. Look at the pictures again and try to guess what there was/wasn't on Inishmore fifty years ago.
exercises.instructionUz: Inishmore — Irlandiyaning g'arbiy qirg'og'i yaqinidagi kichik orol. Rasmlarga yana qarang va ellik yil oldin Inishmoreda nima bor/yo'q bo'lganini taxmin qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU YERDA O'TGAN ZAMON BIRINCHI MARTA ISHLATILADI!

  There IS  → There WAS   (bor edi — birlik)
  There ARE → There WERE  (bor edi — ko'plik)
  There ISN'T → There WASN'T  (yo'q edi — birlik)
  There AREN'T → There WEREN'T (yo'q edi — ko'plik)

QOLIP:
  There WAS a/an + BIRLIK ot.
  There WERE + KO'PLIK ot.
  There WASN'T a/an + BIRLIK ot.
  There WEREN'T any + KO'PLIK ot.

MANTIQ — ELLIK YIL OLDIN NIMA BO'LGAN BO'LISHI MUMKIN:
  ESKI hayotga tegishli: eshak, baliqchi qayiqlari,
     tosh kulba, yashil dalalar
  YANGI hayotga tegishli: aeroport, parom, restoran,
     sovg'a do'koni, mehmon uyi, velosiped

Taxminlar 3 va 4-mashqda tekshiriladi.

tasks.whyUz:
KO'PLIK ot → THERE WERE.
Eshak — eski transport vositasi, o'shanda bo'lgan.

KO'PLIK → THERE WERE.
Baliq ovi — orolning an'anaviy kasbi.

KO'PLIK → THERE WERE.
Tosh kulbalar — orolning eski uylari.

KO'PLIK → THERE WERE.
Dalalar hozir ham bor — ular o'zgarmagan.

BIRLIK va INKOR → THERE WASN'T.
Aeroport — zamonaviy qurilma, ellik yil oldin bo'lmagan.

KO'PLIK va INKOR → THERE WEREN'T ANY.
INKOR gapda ANY ishlatiladi.

KO'PLIK va INKOR → THERE WEREN'T ANY.
Restoran — sayyohlar uchun, o'shanda sayyoh kam edi.

KO'PLIK va INKOR → THERE WEREN'T ANY.
Sovg'a do'koni ham sayyohlar uchun.

KO'PLIK va INKOR → THERE WEREN'T ANY.
Mehmon uyi — sayyohlar uchun turar joy.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the summary about Inishmore, then listen and cross out the wrong word.
exercises.instructionUz: Inishmore haqidagi qisqacha mazmunni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va noto'g'ri so'zni chizib tashlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
QISQACHA MAZMUN (to'g'ri so'zlar bilan):

  Fifty years ago, few tourists could reach Inishmore
  because there wasn't an AIRPORT. Life was DIFFICULT.
  Inishmore was a QUIET place back then. Today there are
  cars, buses and ferry boats. The people have got new,
  modern HOUSES. Inishmore is very BUSY now. There are
  guest houses, restaurants and lots of SOUVENIR shops.
  It is still beautiful, though.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Ellik yil oldin kam sayyoh Inishmorega yetib bora olardi,
  chunki AEROPORT yo'q edi. Hayot QIYIN edi. O'shanda
  Inishmore TINCH joy edi. Bugun mashina, avtobus va
  paromlar bor. Odamlarning yangi, zamonaviy UYLARI bor.
  Inishmore hozir juda GAVJUM. Mehmon uylari, restoranlar
  va ko'plab SOVG'A do'konlari bor. Lekin u hali ham go'zal.

QARAMA-QARSHI JUFTLIKLAR:
  port ↔ airport      difficult ↔ easy
  noisy ↔ quiet       houses ↔ cottages
  boring ↔ busy       clothes ↔ souvenir

DIQQAT — 'CROSS OUT THE WRONG WORD':
  NOTO'G'RI so'zni chizib tashlash kerak,
  ya'ni TO'G'RI so'z qoladi.
exercises.audioNoteUz: Kitobda audio bor, lekin barcha javoblarni 63-betdagi maqoladan ham aniq topish mumkin.

tasks.whyUz:
AEROPORT yo'q edi.
63-betdagi maqolada: 'There wasn't an airport or any ferry boats in those days.'
Bandargoh (port) esa bor edi — qayiqlar to'xtagan.

Hayot QIYIN edi.
Maqolada: 'Life was difficult. We didn't have much money.'
Bugun esa: 'Life is very easy now.'

tasks.prompt: 3  Inishmore was a ............ place back then.
tasks.whyUz:
TINCH joy edi.
Maqolada: 'Inishmore was a quiet place.'
Bugun esa: 'Inishmore is very busy now.'
'back then' = o'sha paytda.

tasks.prompt: 4  The people have got new, modern ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
Bugun ular yangi, zamonaviy UYLARGA ega.
Maqolada: 'We have got new, modern houses.'
Ellik yil oldin esa: 'we only had small stone COTTAGES'.

Hozir juda GAVJUM.
Maqolada: 'Inishmore is very busy now.'
3-band bilan solishtiring: ilgari 'quiet', hozir 'busy'.

SOVG'A do'konlari (sayyohlar uchun).
Maqolada: 'lots of souvenir shops'.
E-rasmda ham 'The Souvenir Shop' yozuvi bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: same, water, fields, cottages, houses, little,
         fifty years, shops, boats, like

Barcha iboralar 62–63-betdagi Inishmore matnlaridan olingan.

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  bo'shliq OLDIDA sifat bo'lsa → OT kerak
     fishing ...... → boats
  bo'shliq KEYINIDA ot bo'lsa → SIFAT kerak
     a ...... island → little

tasks.whyUz:
'a little island' = kichik orol.
63-betdagi maqolada: 'a beautiful little island'.
Gap: Inishmore is a little island.

'fifty years ago' = ellik yil oldin.
'ago' — o'tgan vaqtni bildiradi, DOIM gap oxirida.
Gap: Fifty years ago, life was difficult.

'the same AS' = ...bilan bir xil.
Maqolada: 'exactly the same as it was fifty years ago'.
DIQQAT: 'the same LIKE' XATO — 'as' bo'lishi kerak.

'fishing boats' = baliqchi qayiqlari.
Gap: There were only donkeys and fishing boats.

'stone cottages' = tosh kulbalar.
Gap: They only had small stone cottages.

'running water' = vodoprovod suvi.
Gap: They didn't have electricity or running water.

'just like this' = xuddi shundayligicha.
'like' bu yerda PREDLOG — '...kabi' ('yoqtirmoq' EMAS).
Gap: We're working hard to keep it just like this.

'modern houses' = zamonaviy uylar.
5-band bilan solishtiring: ilgari 'stone cottages', hozir 'modern houses'.
Gap: They have got new, modern houses.

'souvenir shops' = sovg'a do'konlari.
Gap: There are lots of souvenir shops now.

'green fields' = yashil dalalar.
Gap: Coneely looks across the green fields in front of his house.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the opposites of the phrases below, using the words in the list. Then, make sentences using the phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi iboralarning qarama-qarshisini ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan yozing. So'ng iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: busy, big, a lot of

'≠' belgisi QARAMA-QARSHI ma'noni bildiradi.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA GAP:
  Inishmore is a little island.

DIQQAT — 'FEW' va 'A LOT OF':
  few tourists = kam sayyoh (deyarli yo'q)
  a lot of tourists = ko'p sayyoh
  'few' — SANALADIGAN otlar bilan.
  Sanalmaydigan bo'lsa: little ↔ a lot of
     little money ≠ a lot of money

tasks.whyUz:
little ↔ BIG (o'lcham).
Gap: Inishmore is a little island, but Ireland is a big island.

few ↔ A LOT OF (miqdor).
Gap: Fifty years ago there were few tourists, but now there are
a lot of tourists.

quiet ↔ BUSY (gavjumlik).
62-betdagi mashqda ham bor edi.
Gap: Inishmore was a quiet place then, but it is a busy place now.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing prepositions from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan tushib qolgan predloglarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: in front of, on, off, back, in, across, at

DIQQAT: 7 ta so'z, 9 ta bo'shliq —
demak ba'zilari IKKI MARTA ishlatiladi:
  'at' → 2 marta (at first, looking at)
  'in' → 2 marta (in fact, in those days)

Hamma iboralar 63-betdagi maqoladan olingan.
Bu — TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR, ular yodlanadi.

tasks.whyUz:
'ON our page' = sahifamizda.
Gazeta va jurnal sahifasi uchun ON ishlatiladi.

'look AT something' = biror narsaga qaramoq.
DIQQAT: 'look' turli predloglar bilan turli ma'no beradi:
  look AT = qaramoq;  look FOR = qidirmoq;
  look AFTER = qaramoq (parvarish).

'AT first' = dastlab, birinchi qarashda.
DIQQAT: 'at first' ↔ 'at last' (nihoyat).

'IN fact' = aslida, haqiqatda.
'at first' bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yiladi.

'IN those days' = o'sha kunlarda.
O'tgan zamon haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

'IN FRONT OF his house' = uyi oldida.
Aksi: 'behind' (orqasida).

'BACK then' = o'sha paytda.
'in those days' bilan bir xil ma'noda.

'look ACROSS' = ...bo'ylab qaramoq (bir chetdan ikkinchisiga).
'across' = bo'ylab, kesib o'tib.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the magazine article.
exercises.instructionUz: Jurnal maqolasini o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA — 'NOW & THEN' (Hozir va o'shanda) RUKNI.

TUZILISHI:
  1-xatboshi: orol haqida umumiy ma'lumot
  2-xatboshi: ELLIK YIL OLDIN (o'tgan zamon)
  3-xatboshi: BUGUN (hozirgi zamon)
  4-xatboshi: orol aholisining fikri

BU MAQOLADA IKKI ZAMON QIYOSLANADI:
  O'TMISH: was, were, wasn't, weren't, had, didn't have,
           could, couldn't
  HOZIR:   is, are, have got, can

QALIN SO'ZLAR (4-mashqda tushuntiriladi):
  west coast, seems, in fact, islander, reach,
  getting around, running water, in front of

QAHRAMON: Colman Coneely — 70 yoshli orol aholisi.

tasks.en: This week on our Now & Then page, we are looking at Inishmore, a beautiful little island off the west coast of Ireland.
tasks.uz: Bu hafta 'Hozir va o'shanda' sahifamizda biz Inishmore — Irlandiyaning g'arbiy qirg'og'i yaqinidagi go'zal kichik orolni ko'rib chiqamiz.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: the west coast = g'arbiy qirg'oq.
'OFF the coast' = qirg'oq yaqinida (dengizda).
'we are looking at' — Present Continuous (hozirgi son).

tasks.en: At first, Inishmore seems exactly the same as it was fifty years ago, but in fact it is a very different place today.
tasks.uz: Dastlab Inishmore ellik yil oldingidek ko'rinadi, lekin aslida u bugun butunlay boshqa joy.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  seems = ko'rinadi (aslida boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin)
  in fact = aslida, haqiqatda
'At first' = dastlab, birinchi qarashda.
'the same AS' = ...bilan bir xil.

tasks.en: Colman Coneely, a 70-year-old islander, says, "When I was young, few tourists could reach Inishmore."
tasks.uz: Kolman Koneli, 70 yoshli orol aholisi, shunday deydi: «Men yosh bo'lganimda kam sayyoh Inishmorega yetib bora olardi».
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  an islander = orol aholisi (island + -er)
  to reach = yetib bormoq
'a 70-YEAR-OLD islander' — chiziqcha bilan, 'years' EMAS.
'When I WAS young' — o'tgan zamon.
'COULD' = 'can' ning o'tgan zamoni.

tasks.en: "There wasn't an airport or any ferry boats in those days."
tasks.uz: «O'sha kunlarda aeroport ham, parom ham yo'q edi».
tasks.note:
'There WASN'T an airport' — birlik inkor.
'or ANY ferry boats' — inkor gapda ANY.
'in those days' = o'sha kunlarda.

tasks.en: "There were only donkeys and small fishing boats for getting around."
tasks.uz: «Yurish uchun faqat eshaklar va kichik baliqchi qayiqlari bor edi».
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: getting around = yurib turmoq, joydan joyga o'tmoq.
'There WERE' — ko'plik.
'FOR + fe'l-ING' = ...ish uchun.

tasks.en: "Life was difficult. We didn't have much money — we only had small stone cottages."
tasks.uz: «Hayot qiyin edi. Bizda ko'p pul yo'q edi — faqat kichik tosh kulbalarimiz bor edi».
tasks.note:
'HAD' = 'have' ning o'tgan zamoni.
'DIDN'T HAVE' = o'tgan zamon inkori.
'much money' — sanalmaydigan ot bilan MUCH.

tasks.en: "We didn't even have electricity or running water!"
tasks.uz: «Bizda hatto elektr va vodoprovod ham yo'q edi!»
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: running water = vodoprovod suvi (jo'mrakdan oqadigan).
'even' = hatto.
'electricity' = elektr (sanalmaydigan).

tasks.en: "Inishmore was a quiet place — there weren't any guest houses or restaurants back then."
tasks.uz: «Inishmore tinch joy edi — o'shanda mehmon uylari ham, restoranlar ham yo'q edi».
tasks.note:
'There WEREN'T ANY' — ko'plik inkor.
'back then' = o'sha paytda.

tasks.en: Today, up to 2,000 tourists a day can visit Inishmore.
tasks.uz: Bugun kuniga 2000 tagacha sayyoh Inishmorega tashrif buyurishi mumkin.
tasks.note:
'up to' = ...gacha.
'2,000 tourists A DAY' — 'a' = har (kuniga).
Bu yerdan HOZIRGI zamon boshlanadi.

tasks.en: "Now there is an airport," says Coneely. "There are also cars, buses, bicycles and big ferry boats."
tasks.uz: «Hozir aeroport bor, — deydi Koneli. — Mashinalar, avtobuslar, velosipedlar va katta paromlar ham bor».
tasks.note:
'There IS' / 'There ARE' — hozirgi zamon.
Ikkinchi xatboshidagi 'There wasn't an airport' bilan solishtiring.

tasks.en: "Life is very easy now. We have got new, modern houses and a lot of money."
tasks.uz: «Hozir hayot juda oson. Bizda yangi, zamonaviy uylar va ko'p pul bor».
tasks.note:
'Life IS easy' ↔ 'Life WAS difficult'.
'We HAVE GOT' ↔ 'We HAD' / 'We DIDN'T HAVE'.

tasks.en: "We have also got electricity and running water. Inishmore is very busy now."
tasks.uz: «Bizda elektr va vodoprovod ham bor. Inishmore hozir juda gavjum».
tasks.note:
'also' — 'have' va 'got' ORASIDA turadi.
'Inishmore IS busy' ↔ 'Inishmore WAS quiet'.

tasks.en: "There are guest houses, restaurants and lots of souvenir shops."
tasks.uz: «Mehmon uylari, restoranlar va ko'plab sovg'a do'konlari bor».
tasks.note: 'There ARE' ↔ 'There WEREN'T any guest houses or restaurants'.

tasks.en: Coneely looks across the green fields in front of his house and smiles.
tasks.uz: Koneli uyi oldidagi yashil dalalarga qaraydi va tabassum qiladi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: in front of = oldida.
'look ACROSS' = ...bo'ylab qaramoq.

tasks.en: "Yes, Inishmore is beautiful and we're working hard to keep it just like this."
tasks.uz: «Ha, Inishmore go'zal va biz uni shunday saqlab qolish uchun qattiq harakat qilyapmiz».
tasks.note:
'work hard' = qattiq harakat qilmoq.
'keep it just like this' = uni shundayligicha saqlamoq.
'we'RE WORKING' — Present Continuous (hozirgi davr).

exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni maqoladan toping.

tasks.answer: It is a small island off the west coast of Ireland.
tasks.whyUz:
Maqolada: 'Inishmore, a beautiful little island off the west coast of Ireland'.
'OFF the coast' = qirg'oq yaqinida.

tasks.prompt: 2  Could many tourists reach the island fifty years ago? Why (not)?
tasks.answer: No, they couldn't. Few tourists could reach it because there wasn't an airport or any ferry boats.
tasks.whyUz:
'could' savoliga 'couldn't' bilan javob beriladi.
SABAB: 'There wasn't an airport or any ferry boats in those days.'
'few' = kam (deyarli yo'q).
tasks.speak: 2  Could many tourists reach the island fifty years ago? Why (not)?

tasks.prompt: 3  What did the islanders have for getting around?
tasks.answer: They only had donkeys and small fishing boats.
tasks.promptUz: O'sha paytda qanday transport bor edi?
tasks.whyUz:
Maqolada: 'There were only donkeys and small fishing boats for getting around.'
'did ... have' savoliga 'had' bilan javob beriladi.
tasks.speak: 3  What did the islanders have for getting around?

tasks.prompt: 4  What can you find on Inishmore today that wasn't there fifty years ago?
tasks.answer: Today there is an airport, cars, buses, bicycles and big ferry boats. There are also new modern houses, electricity, running water, guest houses, restaurants and souvenir shops.
tasks.whyUz:
Bugun bor, lekin ellik yil oldin bo'lmagan narsalar.
Ikkinchi va uchinchi xatboshini solishtiring.
tasks.speak: 4  What can you find on Inishmore today that wasn't there fifty years ago?

tasks.prompt: 5  What does Colman Coneely think of the island?
tasks.answer: He thinks Inishmore is beautiful. He and the other islanders are working hard to keep it just like this.
tasks.whyUz:
Koneli: 'Yes, Inishmore is beautiful and we're working hard
to keep it just like this.'
'think OF' = ... haqida fikrda bo'lmoq.
tasks.speak: 5  What does Colman Coneely think of the island?

exercises.instructionUz: So'ng qalin yozilgan so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz: Maqoladagi 8 ta qalin so'z.

tasks.whyUz:
'the west coast of Ireland' = Irlandiyaning g'arbiy qirg'og'i.
Boshqa tomonlar: the east/north/south coast.

'Inishmore SEEMS exactly the same' = xuddi o'shanday KO'RINADI.
'seem' — tashqi ko'rinish, haqiqat emas.

'but IN FACT it is a very different place' = lekin aslida u boshqa joy.
'seems' bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yiladi.

island + -er = orolda yashovchi odam.
Shu qoida: New York → a New Yorker;  village → a villager.

'few tourists could REACH Inishmore' = kam sayyoh yetib bora olardi.
DIQQAT: 'reach' dan keyin 'to' KERAK EMAS:
'reach TO Inishmore' XATO.

'for GETTING AROUND' = yurib turish uchun.
'get around' — frazali fe'l (transport haqida).
'for' dan keyin fe'l -ING bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and fill in were(n't), had, was or could(n't).
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va were(n't), had, was yoki could(n't) ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Some ancient Romans WERE very rich and they HAD beautiful
  brick houses. There WEREN'T any windows on the outside
  walls and there WEREN'T any carpets on the floors. Other
  people HAD smaller houses or flats. Ancient Rome HAD
  narrow streets, but there WERE lots of theatres. The
  public baths WERE very popular. Men and women COULD go
  there at different times, but children COULDN'T use the
  baths. Hunting, riding, fishing and having dinner parties
  with friends WERE also popular free-time activities.
  There WERE lots of games and toys for children. The boys'
  favourite games WERE ball games and the girls HAD dolls
  to play with. Children also HAD dogs, cats, ducks and
  geese as pets. The ancient Romans HAD lots of delicious
  food to eat, such as meat, fish, fruit, vegetables and
  bread, and their favourite drink WAS wine.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Ba'zi qadimgi rimliklar juda boy edi va ularning chiroyli
  g'isht uylari bor edi. Tashqi devorlarda deraza yo'q edi
  va polda gilam yo'q edi. Boshqa odamlarning kichikroq
  uylari yoki kvartiralari bor edi. Qadimgi Rimda tor
  ko'chalar bor edi, lekin ko'p teatrlar bor edi. Umumiy
  hammomlar juda mashhur edi. Erkaklar va ayollar u yerga
  turli vaqtlarda bora olardi, lekin bolalar hammomdan
  foydalana olmasdi. Ov qilish, ot minish, baliq ovlash va
  do'stlar bilan ziyofat qilish ham mashhur bo'sh vaqt
  mashg'ulotlari edi. Bolalar uchun ko'p o'yin va o'yinchoq
  bor edi. O'g'il bolalarning sevimli o'yinlari to'p
  o'yinlari edi, qizlarda esa o'ynash uchun qo'g'irchoqlar
  bor edi. Bolalar shuningdek it, mushuk, o'rdak va g'ozni
  uy hayvoni sifatida boqishardi. Qadimgi rimliklarda
  go'sht, baliq, meva, sabzavot va non kabi ko'p mazali
  taomlar bor edi, sevimli ichimliklari esa vino edi.

QAYSI SO'ZNI TANLASH — QOIDA:
  ega + SIFAT/joy      → was / were   (was — birlik)
  ega + NARSA (mulk)   → had
  'There ...' + narsa  → there was / there were
  QOBILIYAT, ruxsat    → could / couldn't

DIQQAT — 'ANY' INKOR BELGISI:
  'There ...... ANY windows' → WEREN'T
  'any' tasdiq gapda deyarli ishlatilmaydi.

tasks.whyUz:
'rich' — SIFAT → 'to be' kerak.
'Romans' ko'plik → WERE.
'ancient' = qadimgi.

'houses' — narsa, mulk → HAD.
'had' hamma ega uchun bir xil.

tasks.prompt: There 3) ............ any windows on the outside walls ...
tasks.whyUz:
'ANY' inkor gapda ishlatiladi → WEREN'T.
'windows' ko'plik → weren't (wasn't emas).
'the outside walls' = tashqi devorlar.
tasks.speak: There 3) ............ any windows on the outside walls ...

tasks.prompt: ... and there 4) ............ any carpets on the floors.
tasks.whyUz:
'ANY carpets' → WEREN'T.
Bu 16c-mashqning 1-savoliga javob:
rimliklarda GILAM yo'q edi.
'a carpet' = gilam; 'the floor' = pol.
tasks.speak: ... and there 4) ............ any carpets on the floors.

tasks.prompt: Other people 5) ............ smaller houses or flats.
tasks.whyUz:
'houses or flats' — mulk → HAD.
'a flat' = kvartira (amerikacha: apartment).
Kambag'alroq odamlar haqida.
tasks.speak: Other people 5) ............ smaller houses or flats.

tasks.whyUz:
'Rome HAD narrow streets' — shahar tuzilishi haqida → HAD.
16a-mashqning 2-bandini tasdiqlaydi.

'There WERE lots of theatres'.
'theatres' ko'plik → WERE.
16c-mashqning 2-savoliga javob.
'lots of' = ko'p.

'popular' SIFAT → 'to be'.
'baths' KO'PLIK → WERE.
'public' = umumiy, hammaga ochiq.

tasks.prompt: Men and women 9) ............ go there at different times, ...
tasks.whyUz:
Keyingi so'z FE'L ('go') → 'could' kerak.
'was/were/had' dan keyin asosiy fe'l kelmaydi.
Ma'nosi: RUXSAT bor edi.
'at different times' = turli vaqtlarda.
tasks.speak: Men and women 9) ............ go there at different times, ...

tasks.whyUz:
'but' oldingi tasdiqqa QARAMA-QARSHI → inkor.
Keyin fe'l ('use') → COULDN'T.
16c-mashqning 3-savoliga javob: BOLALAR foydalana olmasdi.

tasks.prompt: Hunting, riding, fishing and having dinner parties with friends 11) ............ also popular free-time activities.
tasks.speak: Hunting, riding, fishing and having dinner parties with friends 11) ............ also popular free-time activities.

tasks.prompt: There 12) ............ lots of games and toys for children.
tasks.whyUz:
'games and toys' ko'plik → THERE WERE.
16c-mashqning 4-savoliga javob: GAMES.
tasks.speak: There 12) ............ lots of games and toys for children.

tasks.prompt: The boys' favourite games 13) ............ ball games ...
tasks.whyUz:
'games' KO'PLIK → WERE.
DIQQAT — 'the BOYS'' apostrofi 's' dan KEYIN:
ko'plik otda egalik apostrof oxirga qo'yiladi.
tasks.speak: The boys' favourite games 13) ............ ball games ...

tasks.prompt: ... and the girls 14) ............ dolls to play with.
tasks.whyUz:
'dolls' — narsa, mulk → HAD.
16a-mashqning 4-bandini tasdiqlaydi.
'to play with' = o'ynash uchun ('with' oxirda qoladi).
tasks.speak: ... and the girls 14) ............ dolls to play with.

tasks.prompt: Children also 15) ............ dogs, cats, ducks and geese as pets.
tasks.whyUz:
Hayvonlar — 'mulk' → HAD.
'a duck' = o'rdak; 'a goose' → 'GEESE' (noto'g'ri ko'plik!).
'as pets' = uy hayvoni sifatida.
tasks.speak: Children also 15) ............ dogs, cats, ducks and geese as pets.

tasks.prompt: The ancient Romans 16) ............ lots of delicious food to eat, ...
tasks.whyUz:
'food' — narsa → HAD.
'delicious' = mazali.
'such as' = ...kabi, masalan.
tasks.speak: The ancient Romans 16) ............ lots of delicious food to eat, ...

tasks.whyUz:
'their favourite drink' — BIRLIK → WAS (were emas!).
16c-mashqning 6-savoliga javob: WINE.
'wine' = vino.

sections.title: Grammar — Was/Were (past simple of the verb "to be")
sections.titleUz: Grammatika — Was/Were ('to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang.
exercises.explanationUz:
WAS / WERE — 'to be' fe'lining O'TGAN ZAMONI

  TASDIQ (Affirmative)      INKOR (Negative)
  I/he/she/it   WAS         I/he/she/it   WASN'T
  you/we/they   WERE        you/we/they   WEREN'T

  SO'ROQ (Interrogative)    QISQA JAVOB (Short answers)
  WAS I/he/she/it ...?      Yes, I/he/she/it WAS.
                            No, I/he/she/it WASN'T.
  WERE you/we/they ...?     Yes, you/we/they WERE.
                            No, you/we/they WEREN'T.

ESLATMA — HOZIRGI ZAMON BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  am  →  was        I am tired.   →  I was tired.
  is  →  was        He is happy.  →  He was happy.
  are →  were       We are late.  →  We were late.

MUHIM — 'DID' KERAK EMAS:
  'to be' fe'li so'roq va inkorda DID olmaydi.
     Were you at home?     ✓
     Did you be at home?   ✗ XATO

QISQARTMALAR:
  was not  → wasn't
  were not → weren't

THERE WAS / THERE WERE:
  birlik  → There WAS a cinema.
  ko'plik → There WERE two shops.
  inkor   → There wasn't / There weren't
  so'roq  → Was there ...? / Were there ...?

exercises.explanationUz:
HAD — 'have' fe'lining O'TGAN ZAMONI

  TASDIQ         I/you/he, etc  HAD
  INKOR          I/you/he, etc  DIDN'T HAVE
  SO'ROQ         DID  I/you/he, etc  HAVE?
  QISQA JAVOB    Yes, I/you/he, etc DID.
                 No,  I/you/he, etc DIDN'T.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL:
  I had, you had, he had, she had, it had,
  we had, they had — HAMMASI 'HAD'.
  Hech qanday -s yoki boshqa shakl YO'Q.
  (Hozirgi zamonda: I have, he HAS — farq bor edi.)

DIQQAT — INKOR VA SO'ROQDA 'HAVE' QAYTADI:
  I didn't HAVE a car.    ✓
  I didn't HAD a car.     ✗ XATO
  Did you HAVE a car?     ✓
  Did you HAD a car?      ✗ XATO
  Sabab: 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan,
  ikkinchi fe'l ASOSIY shaklda qoladi.

WAS/WERE bilan SOLISHTIRING:
  'to be' → did KERAK EMAS:  Were you at home?
  'have' → did KERAK:        Did you have a car?

Har bir rasm ostida IXTIRO QILINGAN YILI yozilgan.
Qoida juda oddiy:

  yil 1900 dan KEYIN  → ✗ (hali ixtiro qilinmagan edi)

  typewriters       1867  →  ✓
  telephones        1876  →  ✓
  cars              1886  →  ✓

  SB: No, they didn't. Did they have ...

  a hot-air balloon = havo shari
  a typewriter      = yozuv mashinkasi
  a compact disc (CD) = kompakt disk
  a helicopter      = vertolyot

  they didn't HAD    ✗ XATO

exercises.explanationUz:
COULD — 'can' fe'lining O'TGAN ZAMONI

  TASDIQ       I/you/he, etc  COULD swim.
  INKOR        I/you/he, etc  COULDN'T swim.
  SO'ROQ       COULD I/you/he, etc  swim?
  QISQA JAVOB  Yes, I/you/he, etc COULD.
               No,  I/you/he, etc COULDN'T.

UCH MUHIM QOIDA:

  1) HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL — COULD.
     I could, he could, they could — -S YO'Q.

  2) KEYINGI FE'L ASOSIY SHAKLDA, 'to' SIZ:
        I could swim.       ✓
        I could to swim.    ✗ XATO
        I could swam.       ✗ XATO

  3) 'DID' KERAK EMAS:
        Could you swim?     ✓
        Did you could swim? ✗ XATO

QISQARTMA:
  could not → couldn't

MA'NOSI:
  could = qo'lidan kelardi, bila olardi (O'TGAN QOBILIYAT)
  Misol: I could swim when I was five.
         (Besh yoshimda suza olardim.)

DIQQAT — WHEN va UNTIL:
  ... COULD ... WHEN he was one.
     = bir yoshida ALLAQACHON qila olardi
  ... COULDN'T ... UNTIL he was two.
     = ikki yoshigacha qila OLMASDI
       (ya'ni ikki yoshida boshladi)
  'until' DOIM inkor bilan keladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with words from the list below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (18 ta shakl):
  can, can't, could, couldn't,
  was, wasn't, were, weren't,
  is, are, isn't, aren't,
  have got, haven't got, has got, hasn't got,
  had, didn't have

Bu — butun unitning ENG MUHIM mashqi:
hozirgi va o'tgan zamon YONMA-YON solishtiriladi.

TANLASH USULI — UCH SAVOL:

  1) HOZIRGI zamonmi yoki O'TGANmi?
       'now' → hozirgi;  'when I was five', 'fifty years ago',
       'then', 'back then' → o'tgan

  2) QANDAY MA'NO?
       QOBILIYAT (keyin fe'l keladi)  → can / could
       HOLAT, joy, sifat              → is/are  /  was/were
       MULK, egalik                   → have got / had

  3) TASDIQMI yoki INKORmi?
       'any' bo'lsa — deyarli DOIM inkor
       'but' oldingi fikrga qarama-qarshi qo'yadi

JADVAL — HOZIRGI ↔ O'TGAN:
  can        ↔  could
  can't      ↔  couldn't
  is / are   ↔  was / were
  isn't/aren't ↔ wasn't / weren't
  have got   ↔  had
  haven't got ↔ didn't have
  has got    ↔  had

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL (to'ldirilgan holda):

  ┌── THEN (20 yil oldin) ──────┬── NOW (hozir) ──────────────┐
  │ Canary Wharf was a DIRTY    │ Canary Wharf is a CLEAN     │
  │ area twenty years ago.      │ area nowadays.              │
  │                             │                             │
  │ There were EMPTY            │ There are BEAUTIFUL flats,  │
  │ warehouses.                 │ lots of shops, offices,     │
  │                             │ restaurants and cafés.      │
  │ There weren't MANY shops    │                             │
  │ or people.                  │ People have got a lot of    │
  │                             │ money, LOVELY houses and    │
  │ People didn't have MUCH     │ NEW cars.                   │
  │ money or NICE houses        │                             │
  │ or cars.                    │ People can get around by    │
  │                             │ train, bus or taxi.         │
  │ People could only get       │                             │
  │ around by bus or on foot.   │                             │
  └─────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────┘

O'ZBEKCHA:
  ILGARI: Canary Wharf iflos hudud edi. Bo'sh omborlar bor edi.
  Ko'p do'kon yoki odam yo'q edi. Odamlarda ko'p pul, chiroyli
  uy yoki mashina yo'q edi. Faqat avtobusda yoki piyoda yura
  olardilar.
  HOZIR: Canary Wharf toza hudud. Go'zal kvartiralar, ko'p
  do'kon, ofis, restoran va kafelar bor. Odamlarda ko'p pul,
  chiroyli uylar va yangi mashinalar bor. Poyezd, avtobus yoki
  taksida yura oladilar.

JAVOBLAR QANDAY ANIQLANDI:
  Kitob har bir bo'shliqning BIRINCHI HARFINI bergan,
  jadval esa THEN ↔ NOW qarama-qarshiligi ustiga qurilgan.
  Shuning uchun javoblar aniq:
     d... ↔ c...   → DIRTY ↔ CLEAN (iflos ↔ toza)
     e...          → EMPTY warehouses (bo'sh omborlar)
     m... shops    → MANY (inkor 'weren't' bilan)
     m... money    → MUCH (sanalmaydigan 'money' bilan)
     n... houses   → NICE
     b... flats    → BEAUTIFUL
     l... houses   → LOVELY
     n... cars     → NEW

MUCH va MANY FARQI:
  MANY — sanaladigan ko'plik: many shops, many people
  MUCH — sanalmaydigan:       much money, much water
  Ikkalasi ham asosan INKOR va SO'ROQda ishlatiladi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a warehouse = ombor
  an area     = hudud
  nowadays    = hozirgi kunda
  to get around = yurmoq, borib kelmoq
  on foot     = piyoda
  an office   = ofis, idora

exercises.instructionEn: Use the plan below and the information from Ex. 20 to write an article (60-90 words) about Canary Wharf. Use the article in Ex. 4 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rejadan va 20-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Canary Wharf haqida maqola (60-90 so'z) yozing. 4-mashqdagi maqolani namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
REJA (4 XATBOSHI):

  KIRISH
    1-xatboshi: joyning nomini ayting.

  ASOSIY QISM
    2-xatboshi: ILGARI hayot qanday edi —
                there was/were, there wasn't/weren't,
                people didn't have, people could.
    3-xatboshi: HOZIR hayot qanday —
                there is/are, people have got,
                people can.

  XULOSA
    4-xatboshi: joy hozir qanchalik yaxshiligini ayting.

KITOB BERGAN BOSHLANISH (o'zgartirmasdan yoziladi):
  This week on our Now and Then page, we are looking at
  Canary Wharf in London. This area is now completely
  different to what it was like twenty years ago.

KITOB BERGAN TUGASH:
  Canary Wharf is a nice place to live nowadays.

TO'LIQ NAMUNA MAQOLA (85 so'z):

  This week on our Now and Then page, we are looking at
  Canary Wharf in London. This area is now completely
  different to what it was like twenty years ago.

  Twenty years ago, it was a dirty area with empty
  warehouses. There weren't many shops or people and
  people didn't have much money.

  Now there are beautiful flats, shops and cafés. People
  have got lovely houses and new cars, and they can get
  around by train or taxi.

  Canary Wharf is a nice place to live nowadays.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Bu hafta 'Hozir va O'shanda' sahifamizda Londondagi
  Canary Wharf ni ko'rib chiqamiz. Bu hudud yigirma yil
  oldingidan butunlay boshqacha.
  Yigirma yil oldin u bo'sh omborlari bo'lgan iflos hudud
  edi. Ko'p do'kon yoki odam yo'q edi va odamlarda ko'p pul
  yo'q edi.
  Hozir go'zal kvartiralar, do'konlar va kafelar bor.
  Odamlarning chiroyli uylari va yangi mashinalari bor,
  ular poyezd yoki taksida yura oladilar.
  Canary Wharf hozir yashash uchun yaxshi joy.

DIQQAT — SO'Z SONI:
  Kitob bergan kirish va xulosa ham HISOBGA kiradi.
  Kirish 28 so'z, xulosa 9 so'z — demak o'rtadagi ikki
  xatboshiga 23–53 so'z qoladi. Qisqa va aniq yozing.

DIQQAT — ZAMONLARNI ARALASHTIRMANG:
  2-xatboshi — HAMMASI o'tgan zamon
  3-xatboshi — HAMMASI hozirgi zamon

tasks.answer: This week on our Now and Then page, we are looking at Canary Wharf in London. This area is now completely different to what it was like twenty years ago.
Twenty years ago, it was a dirty area with empty warehouses. There weren't many shops or people and people didn't have much money.
Now there are beautiful flats, shops and cafés. People have got lovely houses and new cars, and they can get around by train or taxi.
Canary Wharf is a nice place to live nowadays.

sentencePatterns.formula: There WAS a/an + birlik ot.  /  There WERE + ko'plik ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There was a port. There were donkeys and fishing boats.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bandargoh bor edi. Eshaklar va baliqchi qayiqlari bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'there is' → 'there WAS';  'there are' → 'there WERE'.

sentencePatterns.formula: There WASN'T a/an + birlik.  /  There WEREN'T ANY + ko'plik.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There wasn't an airport. There weren't any guest houses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Aeroport yo'q edi. Mehmon uylari yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: INKOR gapda ANY ishlatiladi (hozirgi zamondagi kabi).

sentencePatterns.formula: Life WAS + sifat.  /  X WAS a + sifat + place.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Life was difficult. Inishmore was a quiet place.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hayot qiyin edi. Inishmore tinch joy edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni: is → WAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: Few tourists COULD + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Few tourists could reach Inishmore.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kam sayyoh Inishmorega yetib bora olardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'can' ning o'tgan zamoni — COULD.
'few' = kam (deyarli yo'q — salbiy ma'no).

sentencePatterns.formula: X is a small island OFF the + tomon + coast OF + mamlakat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Inishmore is a small island off the west coast of Ireland.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Inishmore — Irlandiyaning g'arbiy qirg'og'i yaqinidagi kichik orol.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'OFF the coast' = qirg'oq yaqinida (dengizda).
'the west coast OF Ireland' — 'of' bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is still + sifat, THOUGH.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is still beautiful, though.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Lekin u hali ham go'zal.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'still' = hali ham;  'though' = lekin (gap OXIRIDA).

sentencePatterns.formula: There WAS/WERE ...  ↔  There IS/ARE ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There were only donkeys then. Now there are cars and buses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'shanda faqat eshaklar bor edi. Hozir mashinalar va avtobuslar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'tmish va hozirni qiyoslashning asosiy qolipi.

sentencePatterns.formula: They HAD ...  ↔  They HAVE GOT ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We only had small stone cottages. We have got new, modern houses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bizda faqat kichik tosh kulbalar bor edi. Bizda yangi, zamonaviy uylar bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have got' ning o'tgan zamoni — HAD ('had got' odatda ishlatilmaydi).

sentencePatterns.formula: They DIDN'T HAVE + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We didn't have much money. We didn't even have electricity.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bizda ko'p pul yo'q edi. Bizda hatto elektr ham yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
O'tgan zamon inkori: DIDN'T + fe'l ASOS shaklida.
'didn't HAD' XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: COULD + fe'l  (can ning o'tgan zamoni).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Few tourists could reach Inishmore.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kam sayyoh Inishmorega yetib bora olardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'could' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida ('to' va '-s' YO'Q).

sentencePatterns.formula: X SEEMS ... , but IN FACT ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Inishmore seems exactly the same, but in fact it is a very different place.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Inishmore xuddi o'shanday ko'rinadi, lekin aslida u butunlay boshqa joy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'seem' — tashqi ko'rinish;  'in fact' — haqiqat.
Bu ikkisi doim qarama-qarshi qo'yiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: up to + son + ot + A DAY.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Up to 2,000 tourists a day can visit Inishmore.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kuniga 2000 tagacha sayyoh Inishmorega tashrif buyurishi mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'up to' = eng ko'pi bilan.
'a day' = kuniga ('a' = har).

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is NEXT TO / OPPOSITE the Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The police station is next to the cinema. The school is opposite the cinema.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Militsiya bo'limi kinoteatr yonida. Maktab kinoteatr ro'parasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ko'cha ajratmasa — NEXT TO;  ajratsa — OPPOSITE.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is BETWEEN the Y AND the Z.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The café is between the bank and the post office.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kafe bank va pochta orasida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'between ... AND ...' — 'and' HECH QACHON tushmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: The X is ON THE CORNER OF ... Street AND ... Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The park is on the corner of Apple Street and King Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bog' Apple Street va King Street burchagida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'zgarmas ibora: 'on the corner OF'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Excuse me, can you tell me the way TO the ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the bank?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechirasiz, bankka qanday borishni aytib bera olasizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Notanish odamdan yo'l so'rashning eng muloyim shakli.
'the way TO' — 'to' shart.

sentencePatterns.formula: Go straight down + ko'cha, then take the first turning ON YOUR left/right.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Go straight down Hill Street, then take the first turning on your left.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hill Street bo'ylab to'g'ri yuring, so'ng birinchi burilishdan chapga buriling.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Yo'l ko'rsatish — BUYRUQ gaplar bilan (ega yo'q).

sentencePatterns.formula: X ≠ Y  (qarama-qarshi iboralar).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a little island ≠ a big island;  few tourists ≠ a lot of tourists
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: kichik orol ≠ katta orol;  kam sayyoh ≠ ko'p sayyoh
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
SANALADIGAN: few ↔ a lot of
SANALMAYDIGAN: little ↔ a lot of

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WAS / WERE + ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I was at home. They were at school.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men uyda edim. Ular maktabda edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: I/he/she/it → WAS;  you/we/they → WERE.

sentencePatterns.formula: WAS / WERE + ega + ...?  → Yes, ... was/were. / No, ... wasn't/weren't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Were you at home last night? — No, I wasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun uydamiding? — Yo'q, emasdim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'to be' so'roqda DID OLMAYDI — fe'lning o'zi oldinga chiqadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: WAS there a/an + birlik?  /  WERE there any + ko'plik?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Was there an airport? Were there any bicycles?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Aeroport bormidi? Velosipedlar bormidi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ot BIRLIK bo'lsa WAS, KO'PLIK bo'lsa WERE.
Ko'plikda 'any' qo'shiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + HAD + ... .   (hamma ega uchun bir xil)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They had typewriters. She had a cat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda yozuv mashinkasi bor edi. Unda mushuk bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: HAD — hech qachon o'zgarmaydi, -s olmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + DIDN'T HAVE + ... .   /   DID + ega + HAVE + ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They didn't have computers. Did they have helicopters?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda kompyuter yo'q edi. Ularda vertolyot bormidi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'did/didn't' dan keyin HAVE (had EMAS) — bu eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

sentencePatterns.formula: They had X 100 years ago, BUT they didn't have Y.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They had hot-air balloons 100 years ago, but they didn't have helicopters.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 100 yil oldin havo sharlari bor edi, lekin vertolyotlar yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' — qarama-qarshilikni bog'laydi, oldidan VERGUL.

sentencePatterns.formula: What was + ega + LIKE?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What was your best friend like? — He was funny and kind.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eng yaqin do'sting qanday edi? — U qiziqarli va mehribon edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: XARAKTER so'raladi. Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + COULD / COULDN'T + asosiy fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Men and women could go there. Children couldn't use the baths.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Erkaklar va ayollar bora olardi. Bolalar hammomdan foydalana olmasdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'could' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' siz va -ed siz.

sentencePatterns.formula: X could ... WHEN he was [yosh], but Y couldn't ... UNTIL he was [yosh].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paul could talk when he was one, but Doug couldn't talk until he was two.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pol bir yoshida gapira olardi, lekin Dag ikki yoshigacha gapira olmasdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: TASDIQ → when;  INKOR → until.

sentencePatterns.formula: There WEREN'T ANY + ko'plik ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There weren't any windows on the outside walls.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tashqi devorlarda deraza yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'any' inkor va so'roq gaplarda ishlatiladi, tasdiqda emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + HAD + narsa.   ↔   There WAS/WERE + narsa.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They had dolls. There were lots of toys.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda qo'g'irchoq bor edi. Ko'p o'yinchoq bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
HAD — kimdadir bor edi (EGA bor).
THERE WAS/WERE — umuman mavjud edi (ega yo'q).

sentencePatterns.formula: ..., such as A, B, C and D.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: lots of delicious food, such as meat, fish, fruit, vegetables and bread
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: go'sht, baliq, meva, sabzavot va non kabi ko'p mazali taomlar
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'such as' = ...kabi, masalan — misol keltiradi.
Oxirgi ikki so'z 'and' bilan bog'lanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: -ing shakli + WERE + popular activities.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hunting, riding and fishing were popular free-time activities.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ov qilish, ot minish va baliq ovlash mashhur mashg'ulotlar edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Mashg'ulot nomlari -ing bilan yasaladi va OT vazifasini bajaradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOZIR: There is/are ... .   ILGARI: There was/were ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a bank opposite the cinema, but fifty years ago there wasn't a bank.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kinoteatr ro'parasida bank bor, lekin ellik yil oldin bank yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'now' → is/are;  'fifty years ago', 'then' → was/were.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOZIR: have/has got ... .   ILGARI: had ... / didn't have ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Now he has got three dogs, but he hasn't got any cats. When he was five, he had a cat.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hozir uning uchta iti bor, lekin mushugi yo'q. Besh yoshida mushugi bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have got' ning o'tgan shakli — HAD (has got ham HAD).

sentencePatterns.formula: HOZIR: can + fe'l.   ILGARI: could + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When I was five, I could ride a bicycle, but I couldn't ride a motor bike. Now I can ride it very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Besh yoshimda velosiped hayday olardim, lekin mototsikl hayday olmasdim. Hozir uni juda yaxshi haydayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can/could' dan KEYIN doim FE'L keladi; 'have got' dan keyin OT.

sentencePatterns.formula: There weren't MANY + sanaladigan.   People didn't have MUCH + sanalmaydigan.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There weren't many shops or people. People didn't have much money.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'p do'kon yoki odam yo'q edi. Odamlarda ko'p pul yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: MANY — sanaladigan ko'plik;  MUCH — sanalmaydigan.

sentencePatterns.formula: People could ONLY get around BY bus or ON foot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: People could only get around by bus or on foot.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odamlar faqat avtobusda yoki piyoda yura olardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'only' cheklovni bildiradi.
Transport — BY, lekin PIYODA — ON foot.

sentencePatterns.formula: This area is now completely different to what it was like twenty years ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This area is now completely different to what it was like twenty years ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu hudud yigirma yil oldingidan butunlay boshqacha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'then-and-now' maqolasining tayyor kirish qolipi.
'different to' (britancha) = 'different from'.
